name: No Sex Before Marriage
overview: Scripture teaches that sexual intimacy is designed by God to be experienced within the covenant of marriage, where a man and woman become one flesh as established from creation (Genesis 2:24; Mark 10:6). Engaging in sexual relations outside of this sacred union is identified with works of the flesh such as fornication and uncleanness, which believers are called to avoid completely (Galatians 5:19; Ephesians 5:3). The command to live as followers of God includes honoring His design for purity and holiness in all aspects of life, including sexual conduct (Ephesians 5:1). Furthermore, the law in Exodus underscores the seriousness of sexual relations outside of marriage by requiring a man who lies with an unbetrothed woman to take responsibility through marriage (Exodus 22:16).
